metadata.title: Homemade Pickle Masala
metadata.description:
Pickle masala is a mixture of aromatic spices which gives the pickle its wonderful taste. 

If  not 100 there might be 1000 different ways of making pickle masala, in this video I am showing you a very basic recipe for making pickle masala. 

This is my favorite version of pickle masala as it's quick and easy to make and is quite versatile to work with. You can instantly pickle meat or vegetables of your choice.
